name: CAMI benchmarking toolkit
description: A toolkit and standardized workflow for assessing metagenomics software performance using CAMI datasets, metrics, and community-driven evaluation protocols.
evaluation_method: F1 (with task-specific metrics such as precision/recall, ARI, completeness/purity)
general_score_metric: composite_score (task-specific F1 and related metrics aggregated into task rankings)
typical_sota_score: varies widely by task (no single overall SOTA)
reputation: Widely used and respected in the metagenomics community as the standard community-driven benchmark suite for evaluating metagenomics tools.
notes: Domain-specific, non-LLM benchmark with many task-specific metrics; results are highly task- and dataset-dependent (simulated + real CAMI datasets); care needed interpreting composite rankings and contamination/assembly biases.
